facts.description: Actor is a fund manager within paragraph 28 scope; units: actor
facts.name: fund_manager

facts.description: The stated investment objective of the fund is to invest in virtual assets as defined by the cited AMLO provision; tokenised securities alone do not satisfy this classification; units: fund objective
facts.name: va_objective

facts.description: Intended investment in AMLO virtual assets as a proportion of fund gross asset value, excluding tokenised securities; 100 basis points equals 1 percent; units: basis points of GAV
facts.name: intended_va_bps

interpretations.statement: Unreviewed interpretation: [TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] The selected VA de-minimis trigger applies to a paragraph 28 fund manager if the fund either has a stated objective to invest in AMLO virtual assets or intends to invest at least 10% of GAV in those assets, excluding Tokenised Securities. False means only that this selected trigger does not apply; unknown inputs remain unknown where they prevent determination.
